releaseNotes: Adds optional Discord Rich Presence with track/session and privacy controls, off by default. Adds subtle player-tyre smoke for lock-ups, wheelspin and slides in the local radar, with a Customize toggle and replay pause/seek support. Fixes qualifying out-lap map visibility and excludes unused cars and ghost slots from Time Trial views. Uses a compact 52px header with equal dashboard gaps, improves Vehicle and Rival page fit, styles remaining checkboxes, and shows neutral readouts when telemetry is unavailable.
